# 04.04-build-validation: Final build validation and cleanup

## Objective
Ensure solution builds cleanly with zero errors and zero API-related warnings.

## Scope
- Run full solution build
- Fix any remaining compilation errors revealed after previous subtasks
- Address any build warnings related to API incompatibility
- Verify application launches (smoke test)

## Done when
- Build: Success (zero errors)
- Warnings: Zero API-related warnings
- Application: Launches without crash
- All 19+ original errors from Task 01 resolved
